content.raw_text: 哈利在流血。他左手捏住右手，嘴里不出声地骂着，用肩膀推开卧室的门。脚下突然发出瓷器碎裂的嘎吱声：一杯凉茶放在他卧室门外的地上，他一脚踩了上去。

sentences.text: 哈利在流血。
sentences.translation: Harry is bleeding.
sentences.explanation: The structure 在 + verb indicates an ongoing action, similar to the present continuous tense in English.

sentences.text: 他左手捏住右手，嘴里不出声地骂着，用肩膀推开卧室的门。
sentences.translation: He held his right hand with his left hand, cursing silently in his mouth, and pushed open the bedroom door with his shoulder.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains a complex structure where multiple actions are happening simultaneously. It also includes the use of adverbial particles to describe how the actions are carried out.

sentences.text: 脚下突然发出瓷器碎裂的嘎吱声：一杯凉茶放在他卧室门外的地上，他一脚踩了上去。
sentences.translation: Underfoot suddenly came the sound of porcelain shattering: a glass of cold tea placed outside his bedroom door, he stepped on it.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a glass of cold tea being accidentally stepped on outside the protagonist's bedroom door, causing it to shatter.

sentences.text: “怎么——
sentences.translation: How—
sentences.explanation: The em dash '——' in Chinese text is often used to indicate an interruption or a sudden break in speech or thought.
The sentence consists of a single question mark, indicating a question or uncertainty.
This sentence consists of opening and closing quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 哈利四下张望，女贞路四号的楼梯平台上空无一人。这杯茶大概是达力自作聪明，想给他搞个恶作剧吧。哈利高举着流血的手，用另一只手捡起茶杯碎片，扔进卧室门后那个已经满满当当的垃圾箱里。然后他穿过房间走进浴室，把手指放在水龙头下冲洗。

sentences.text: 哈利四下张望，女贞路四号的楼梯平台上空无一人。
sentences.translation: Harry looked around, and there was no one on the staircase platform of No. 4 Privet Drive.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes Harry looking around and noticing that there is no one on the staircase platform of No. 4 Privet Drive. The structure '空无一人' is a formal way of saying 'no one'.

sentences.text: 这杯茶大概是达力自作聪明，想给他搞个恶作剧吧。
sentences.translation: This cup of tea is probably Dali trying to be clever, wanting to play a prank on him.
sentences.explanation: The phrase '自作聪明' means 'trying to be clever'. The structure '想给他搞个' indicates 'wanting to play a prank on him'.

sentences.text: 哈利高举着流血的手，用另一只手捡起茶杯碎片，扔进卧室门后那个已经满满当当的垃圾箱里。
sentences.translation: Harry raised his bloody hand high, picked up the teacup shards with his other hand, and threw them into the already full trash can behind the bedroom door.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains a complex structure with multiple actions happening simultaneously. It also includes measure words and possessive particles commonly used in Chinese.

measure word for animals or one of a pair

sentences.text: 然后他穿过房间走进浴室，把手指放在水龙头下冲洗。
sentences.translation: Then he walked through the room into the bathroom, and rinsed his fingers under the faucet.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...放在...' is a common way in Chinese to indicate placing an object somewhere.

words.definition: indicating the object of an action

content.raw_text: 还有四天不能使用魔法，这真是愚蠢，毫无道理，令人恼火……但他不得不承认，手指上这个深深的伤口肯定使他不能得心应手。他从来没学会怎样修复创伤，现在想来——特别是想到他的下一步计划——这似乎是他魔法教育中的一个严重缺陷。他一边暗自决定下次向赫敏请教这个问题，一边拿一大团手纸尽量擦去地板上的茶渍，然后回到卧室，重重地关上了房门。

sentences.text: 还有四天不能使用魔法，这真是愚蠢，毫无道理，令人恼火…
sentences.translation: There are still four days when magic cannot be used, this is truly foolish, unreasonable, and infuriating...
sentences.explanation: The sentence expresses frustration and disbelief about not being able to use magic for four days, using strong language to convey the speaker's emotions.
The sentence contains an ellipsis, indicating that there is more text being omitted or left out.

sentences.text: 但他不得不承认，手指上这个深深的伤口肯定使他不能得心应手。
sentences.translation: But he had to admit that this deep wound on his finger was definitely hindering his skillful performance.
sentences.explanation: The structure '使...不能...' means 'make...cannot...' in this sentence.

sentences.text: 他从来没学会怎样修复创伤，现在想来——
sentences.translation: He never learned how to repair wounds, now he thinks—
sentences.explanation: The structure '从来没' is a common way to express 'never' in Chinese. The use of '想来' at the end of the sentence indicates the character is reflecting on past events.

sentences.text: 特别是想到他的下一步计划——
sentences.translation: Especially when thinking about his next plan—
sentences.explanation: The structure '想到他的下一步计划' means 'thinking about his next plan'. The em dash '——' is used to indicate a pause or interruption in thought.

sentences.text: 这似乎是他魔法教育中的一个严重缺陷。
sentences.translation: This seems to be a serious flaw in his magical education.
sentences.explanation: The structure '中的' is used to indicate 'in' or 'within' a certain context or scope.

sentences.text: 他一边暗自决定下次向赫敏请教这个问题，一边拿一大团手纸尽量擦去地板上的茶渍，然后回到卧室，重重地关上了房门。
sentences.translation: He decided to ask Hermione about this question next time while wiping the tea stains on the floor with a large wad of tissue, then he returned to the bedroom and closed the door heavily.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of '一边...一边' structure to indicate simultaneous actions, as well as the verb-object structure commonly seen in Chinese sentences.

content.raw_text: 早上，哈利彻底清空了他上学用的箱子，这是他六年前装箱以来的第一次。以前每次开学，他都是把箱子上面四分之三的东西替换、更新一下，箱底一直留着一层乱七八糟的杂物——旧的羽毛笔，枯干的甲虫眼睛，早已穿不下的配不成对的袜子。几分钟前，哈利把手伸进这层杂物，右手的无名指突然一阵钻心的剧痛，抽出来一看，已经血流如注。

sentences.text: 早上，哈利彻底清空了他上学用的箱子，这是他六年前装箱以来的第一次。
sentences.translation: In the morning, Harry completely emptied the box he used for school, this was the first time since he packed it six years ago.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of possessive particles '的' and '了', as well as the structure '以来' to indicate 'since'.

sentences.text: 以前每次开学，他都是把箱子上面四分之三的东西替换，更新一下，箱底一直留着一层乱七八糟的杂物——
sentences.translation: In the past, every time school started, he would replace and update about three-quarters of the things on top of the box, while the bottom of the box always had a layer of miscellaneous items.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes a habit of the person in the past when school started, emphasizing the action of replacing and updating most of the items on top of the box while keeping a messy layer of miscellaneous items at the bottom.

sentences.text: 旧的羽毛笔，枯干的甲虫眼睛，早已穿不下的配不成对的袜子。
sentences.translation: The old feather pen, the dried beetle eyes, the mismatched socks that no longer fit.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes a collection of old, worn-out items that are no longer useful or matching.

sentences.text: 几分钟前，哈利把手伸进这层杂物，右手的无名指突然一阵钻心的剧痛，抽出来一看，已经血流如注。
sentences.translation: A few minutes ago, Harry reached into this layer of clutter, and suddenly felt a sharp, piercing pain in his ring finger on his right hand. When he pulled it out and looked, blood was flowing profusely.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes the moment when Harry felt a sudden sharp pain in his ring finger while reaching into clutter, resulting in profuse bleeding.

words.definition: used to indicate the object of a verb

content.raw_text: 现在他的动作比较谨慎了。他重新跪在箱子旁边，在箱底小心摸索着，掏出一个破旧的徽章，上面交替闪烁着支持塞德里克·迪戈里和波特臭大粪的淡淡字样；接着他又掏出了一个破旧开裂的窥镜和一个金挂坠盒，盒子里藏着一张签名为R．A．B．的字条，最后发现了划伤他手指的利刃。他立刻认了出来，那是已故教父小天狼星送给他的魔镜碎片，有两英寸长。哈利把它放在一边，小心翼翼地在箱子里寻找其他残片，可是教父的最后一件礼物只剩下了星星点点的玻璃碎屑，粘在箱子的最底层，像亮晶晶的粗砂粒。

sentences.text: 现在他的动作比较谨慎了。
sentences.translation: Now his actions are more cautious.
sentences.explanation: The structure '比较 + adjective + 了' is used to indicate a comparison where the subject's actions are now more cautious.

words.definition: indicates a change of situation or completion

sentences.text: 他重新跪在箱子旁边，在箱底小心摸索着，掏出一个破旧的徽章，上面交替闪烁着支持塞德里克·迪戈里和波特臭大粪的淡淡字样；
sentences.translation: He knelt again beside the box, carefully searching at the bottom of the box, and pulled out a worn badge, on which the faint words supporting Cedric Diggory and Potter's stinking dung alternately flickered.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains complex vocabulary related to specific names and cultural references. The structure of indicating continuous or habitual action with '着' might be challenging for learners.

words.pinyin: sāi dé lǐ kè · dí gē lǐ

sentences.text: 接着他又掏出了一个破旧开裂的窥镜和一个金挂坠盒，盒子里藏着一张签名为R．A．B．的字条，最后发现了划伤他手指的利刃。
sentences.translation: Then he took out a broken and cracked peephole mirror and a gold pendant box, inside the box was a note signed R.A.B., and finally found the blade that had cut his finger.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains a list of items found by the character, using a series of descriptive words and possessive particles to indicate ownership and characteristics of the objects.

sentences.text: 他立刻认了出来，那是已故教父小天狼星送给他的魔镜碎片，有两英寸长。
sentences.translation: He immediately recognized it, that was the magic mirror fragment that his late godfather Sirius Black had given him, two inches long.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains possessive particles (的) and a structure where the verb (认) is followed by a complement (出来) to indicate completion of the action.

sentences.text: 哈利把它放在一边，小心翼翼地在箱子里寻找其他残片，可是教父的最后一件礼物只剩下了星星点点的玻璃碎屑，粘在箱子的最底层，像亮晶晶的粗砂粒。
sentences.translation: Harry set it aside and carefully searched for other fragments in the box, but the last gift from his godfather only had scattered glass shards left, sticking to the bottom of the box like shiny grains of coarse sand.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains descriptive language and metaphorical expressions, which may pose a challenge for intermediate learners. Pay attention to the use of possessive particles and adverbial phrases.

content.raw_text: 哈利直起身子，仔细端详着那块划伤他手指、边缘不齐的碎片，在里面只看见自己的一双明亮的绿眼睛。他把破镜片放在床上那份早晨刚送到、还没有看过的《预言家日报》上，转身去对付箱子里剩下的垃圾，想以此遏制突然涌上心头的痛苦回忆，那些由破碎的镜片引起的揪心的悔恨和思念。

sentences.text: 哈利直起身子，仔细端详着那块划伤他手指，边缘不齐的碎片，在里面只看见自己的一双明亮的绿眼睛。
sentences.translation: Harry sat up straight, carefully examining the scratched, uneven edge piece that only showed his own bright green eyes.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains descriptive details about Harry examining a piece with his own eyes. The use of possessive particles and the structure of the sentence may be challenging for intermediate learners.

sentences.text: 他把破镜片放在床上那份早晨刚送到，还没有看过的《预言家日报》上，转身去对付箱子里剩下的垃圾，想以此遏制突然涌上心头的痛苦回忆，那些由破碎的镜片引起的揪心的悔恨和思念。
sentences.translation: He placed the broken mirror pieces on the morning's freshly delivered, unread 'Prophet Daily' on the bed, then turned to deal with the remaining trash in the box, hoping to suppress the sudden surge of painful memories, the heart-wrenching regrets and longing caused by the shattered mirror pieces.
sentences.explanation: This sentence includes complex structures like '把' to indicate the object of the verb, possessive particles '的', and the use of '那些' to refer to 'those'. The sentence also contains emotional vocabulary like '痛苦' (painful) and '悔恨' (regrets).

content.raw_text: 他又花了一小时才把箱子彻底清空，扔掉没用的东西，剩下的根据以后是否需要分成了几堆。学院长袍、魁地奇队袍、坩埚、羊皮纸、羽毛笔以及大多数课本都堆在一个墙角，留在家里。不知道姨妈姨父会怎么处理它们，没准是半夜三更一把火烧掉，就好像它们是某种滔天大罪的证据。他的麻瓜衣服、隐形衣、配制魔药的用具、几本书，还有海格以前送给他的那本相册、一沓信件和魔杖则放进了一只旧背包里。背包前兜里塞着活点地图和装着R．A．B．签名字条的金挂坠盒。把挂坠盒放在这么重要的位置，不是因为它有多么珍贵——按常理说，它毫无价值——而是因为获取它所付出的代价。

sentences.text: 他又花了一小时才把箱子彻底清空，扔掉没用的东西，剩下的根据以后是否需要分成了几堆。
sentences.translation: He spent another hour before completely emptying the box, throwing away useless things, and dividing the rest into several piles based on whether they would be needed in the future.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the use of the particle '了' to indicate the completion of an action, as well as the structure of '根据...分成...' meaning 'divide into based on'.

words.definition: particle marking the following noun as the object of a verb

sentences.text: 学院长袍，魁地奇队袍，坩埚，羊皮纸，羽毛笔以及大多数课本都堆在一个墙角，留在家里。
sentences.translation: Academic robes, Quidditch team robes, cauldrons, parchment, quills, and most textbooks were piled up in a corner, left at home.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes various items like academic robes, Quidditch team robes, cauldrons, parchment, quills, and textbooks being piled up in a corner and left at home.

sentences.text: 不知道姨妈姨父会怎么处理它们，没准是半夜三更一把火烧掉就好像它们是某种滔天大罪的证据。
sentences.translation: I don't know how my aunt and uncle will handle them. Maybe they will burn them in the middle of the night as if they were evidence of some heinous crime.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a hypothetical situation where the speaker is unsure how their aunt and uncle will handle something, suggesting they might burn it as if it were evidence of a serious crime.

sentences.text: 他的麻瓜衣服，隐形衣，配制魔药的用具，几本书，还有海格以前送给他的那本相册，一沓信件和魔杖则放进了一只旧背包里。
sentences.translation: His Muggle clothes, invisibility cloak, tools for potion-making, a few books, as well as the album Hagrid gave him before, a stack of letters, and his wand were all put into an old backpack.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains a list of items being put into a backpack, using various measure words for different objects. The use of particles like 的, 了, and 还有 may be confusing for intermediate learners.

sentences.text: 背包前兜里塞着活点地图和装着R．A．B签名字条的金挂坠盒。
sentences.translation: In the front pocket of the backpack, there is a live map and a gold pendant box containing a signature note from R.A.B.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains a structure where the verb 'containing' is used twice to describe what is inside the gold pendant box. The use of 'R.A.B.' as a signature may be a reference or abbreviation specific to the context of the text.

sentences.text: 把挂坠盒放在这么重要的位置，不是因为它有多么珍贵——
sentences.translation: Putting the pendant box in such an important position, not because it is so precious —
sentences.explanation: The structure '不是因为...而是因为...' (not because... but because...) is commonly used in Chinese to contrast reasons or explanations.

words.definition: particle used to indicate the object of a verb

sentences.text: 按常理说，它毫无价值——
sentences.translation: According to common sense, it is completely worthless—
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is straightforward, but the use of 毫无 (completely without) might be a new vocabulary term for intermediate learners.

sentences.text: 而是因为获取它所付出的代价。
sentences.translation: but because of the cost it takes to obtain it.
sentences.explanation: The structure '因为...所' is a common way to express 'because of' in Chinese.

content.raw_text: 现在，只剩下桌上他的雪袅海德薇旁边的那一大堆报纸了：哈利在女贞路过暑假，每天都有一份。

sentences.text: 现在，只剩下桌上他的雪袅海德薇旁边的那一大堆报纸了：哈利在女贞路过暑假，每天都有一份。
sentences.translation: Now, only the large pile of newspapers next to his Snow White Hedwig on the table remains: Harry passed the summer on Privet Drive, receiving one every day.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains possessive particles, a structure indicating the completion of an action, and the use of '每天' (every day) to express frequency.

content.raw_text: 他从地上站起来，伸了个懒腰，朝书桌走去。他飞快地翻看着报纸，把它们一份份扔到那堆垃圾上，海德薇在旁边一动不动。猫头鹰睡着了，也许它是在装睡。它在生哈利的气，因为这段时间让它出笼的时间太少了。

sentences.text: 他从地上站起来，伸了个懒腰，朝书桌走去。
sentences.translation: He stood up from the ground, stretched lazily, and walked towards the desk.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of directional verbs like '从' (from) and '朝' (towards) to indicate movement. The measure word '个' is used before '懒腰' (lazily) to quantify the action of stretching.

sentences.text: 他飞快地翻看着报纸，把它们一份份扔到那堆垃圾上，海德薇在旁边一动不动。
sentences.translation: He quickly flipped through the newspapers, throwing them one by one onto the pile of garbage, while Heidi stood motionless beside him.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the particle '把' to indicate the object of the verb, as well as the structure '一...一...' to express doing something one by one.

words.definition: indicating the object of the verb

sentences.text: 猫头鹰睡着了，也许它是在装睡。
sentences.translation: The owl fell asleep, maybe it's pretending to sleep.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the owl falling asleep, suggesting that it might be pretending to sleep.

sentences.text: 它在生哈利的气，因为这段时间让它出笼的时间太少了。
sentences.translation: It is angry with Harry because it has had too little time out of its cage during this period.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese can be different from English, with the possessive particle '的' coming after the noun it possesses. Also, the use of '让' in this context means 'let/make', indicating that something caused the situation described in the sentence.

content.raw_text: 那堆报纸快要见底的时候，哈利的速度慢了下来，他在寻找他来女贞路过暑假后不久送来的那期报纸。他记得头版上有一小条关于霍格沃茨学校的麻瓜研究课教师凯瑞迪·布巴吉辞职的消息。好，终于找到了。他翻到第10版，坐在书桌前的椅子上，再次阅读他一直寻找的那篇文章。

sentences.text: 那堆报纸快要见底的时候，哈利的速度慢了下来，他在寻找他来女贞路过暑假后不久送来的那期报纸。
sentences.translation: When the stack of newspapers was about to run out, Harry's speed slowed down, as he was looking for the issue of the newspaper that had been sent to him shortly after passing by Privet Drive during the summer vacation.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains possessive particles '的' and '了' indicating possession and completion of an action respectively. The structure '他在寻找...送来的那期报纸' is a complex way of saying 'he was looking for the issue of the newspaper that had been sent'.

sentences.text: 他记得头版上有一小条关于霍格沃茨学校的麻瓜研究课教师凯瑞迪·布巴吉辞职的消息。
sentences.translation: He remembered there was a small piece on the front page about Muggle Studies teacher Kari Dibbaji resigning from Hogwarts School.
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces the concept of Muggle Studies and the resignation of a teacher from Hogwarts School, which may be unfamiliar to some learners.

sentences.text: 好，终于找到了。
sentences.translation: Okay, finally found it.
sentences.explanation: The structure '终于找到了' indicates the completion of an action, emphasizing the relief or satisfaction of finally achieving something.

sentences.text: 他翻到第10版，坐在书桌前的椅子上，再次阅读他一直寻找的那篇文章。
sentences.translation: He turned to the 10th edition, sat on the chair in front of the desk, and read again the article he had been looking for.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of ordinal numbers, possessive particles, and the structure of 'noun + 的 + noun' to indicate possession.

sentences.text: 怀念阿不思·邓布利多
sentences.translation: Remembering Albus Dumbledore
sentences.explanation: The sentence expresses the act of remembering or reminiscing about Albus Dumbledore, a character from the Harry Potter series.

sentences.translation: Ephias Doji
sentences.explanation: This sentence consists of two names, '埃' (Ephias) and '非' (Doji), without any tricky grammar structures or cultural phrases.

content.raw_text: 我是进入霍格沃茨的那天认识阿不思·邓布利多的，当时我十一岁。我们之所以相互吸引，无疑是因为我们都觉得自己是局外人。我入学前不久染上了龙痘疮，虽然不再传染，但我满脸痘疮，肤色发青，没有多少人愿意接近我。阿不思呢，他是顶着恶名的压力来到霍格沃茨的。就在不到一年前，他父亲珀西瓦尔凶残地袭击了三个年轻麻瓜，事情闹得沸沸扬扬。阿不思从不试图否认他父亲（在阿兹卡班终身监禁）犯有这桩罪行。相反，当我鼓起勇气问他时，他向我明确表示他知道父亲有罪。除此之外，邓布利多拒绝谈论这件令人伤心的事，虽然有许多人想套他的话，有人甚至津津乐道地赞扬他父亲的行为，并断定阿不思也是个仇视麻瓜的人。但是他们大错特错了——凡是认识阿不思的人都可以证明，他从未表露过丝毫反麻瓜倾向。事实上，他日后坚决维护麻瓜权益的做法为他树敌不少。

sentences.text: 我是进入霍格沃茨的那天认识阿不思·邓布利多的，当时我十一岁。
sentences.translation: I met Albus Dumbledore on the day I entered Hogwarts, when I was eleven years old.
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces the speaker meeting Albus Dumbledore on the day they entered Hogwarts at the age of eleven.

sentences.text: 我们之所以相互吸引，无疑是因为我们都觉得自己是局外人。
sentences.translation: The reason we are attracted to each other is undoubtedly because we both feel like outsiders.
sentences.explanation: The sentence emphasizes the mutual attraction between two individuals who both feel like outsiders, highlighting a sense of connection through shared experiences of feeling out of place.

sentences.text: 我入学前不久染上了龙痘疮，虽然不再传染，但我满脸痘疮，肤色发青，没有多少人愿意接近我。
sentences.translation: Shortly before I entered school, I contracted smallpox. Although it was no longer contagious, my face was covered in pockmarks, my complexion turned blue, and not many people were willing to approach me.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the speaker contracting smallpox before entering school, resulting in facial pockmarks and a blue complexion that made people reluctant to be near them.

sentences.text: 阿不思呢，他是顶着恶名的压力来到霍格沃茨的。
sentences.translation: As for Harry, he came to Hogwarts under the pressure of a bad reputation.
sentences.explanation: The structure '顶着 + noun' means 'to bear (pressure)'. The use of '呢' at the beginning of the sentence is a common way to indicate the topic of discussion.

words.definition: particle indicating the topic of the sentence

sentences.text: 就在不到一年前，他父亲珀西瓦尔凶残地袭击了三个年轻麻瓜，事情闹得沸沸扬扬。
sentences.translation: Just under a year ago, his father Percy viciously attacked three young Muggles, causing a big stir.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Time + Action, which is different from English. The term '麻瓜' (Muggles) is a term from the Harry Potter series, referring to non-magical people.

sentences.text: 阿不思从不试图否认他父亲（在阿兹卡班终身监禁）犯有这桩罪行。
sentences.translation: Harry never tried to deny that his father (was imprisoned for life in Azkaban) committed this crime.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + 从不 + Verb + Object, which emphasizes the negative action of 'never tried to deny'. The use of parentheses (（）) indicates additional information about the father being imprisoned in Azkaban for life.

sentences.text: 相反，当我鼓起勇气问他时，他向我明确表示他知道父亲有罪。
sentences.translation: On the contrary, when I gathered the courage to ask him, he clearly indicated to me that he knew my father was guilty.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the word '相反' (on the contrary) to contrast two situations. The structure '当...时' is used to indicate 'when' something happens. The phrase '明确表示' means 'clearly indicated'.

sentences.text: 除此之外，邓布利多拒绝谈论这件令人伤心的事，虽然有许多人想套他的话，有人甚至津津乐道地赞扬他父亲的行为，并断定阿不思也是个仇视麻瓜的人。
sentences.translation: In addition, Dumbledore refused to discuss this heartbreaking matter, although many people wanted to trap his words, some even praised his father's actions and concluded that Aberforth was also a person who despised Muggles.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains complex structures such as possessive particles (的) and adverbial particles (地), as well as idiomatic phrases like '津津乐道' (praise enthusiastically).

sentences.text: 但是他们大错特错了——
sentences.translation: But they were completely wrong—
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese may seem different from English, where the verb '错' (wrong) is repeated for emphasis, and '了' is used to indicate completion of the action.

sentences.text: 凡是认识阿不思的人都可以证明，他从未表露过丝毫反麻瓜倾向。
sentences.translation: Everyone who knows Albus can attest that he has never shown the slightest anti-Muggle tendency.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Predicate + Object. The tricky part here might be the word '丝毫' which means 'slightest' and the term '反麻瓜倾向' which refers to 'anti-Muggle tendency' in the context of the Harry Potter universe.

sentences.text: 事实上，他日后坚决维护麻瓜权益的做法为他树敌不少。
sentences.translation: In fact, his resolute defense of Muggle rights later made him many enemies.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure may seem complex with the use of '的' to indicate possession and the placement of '为' before '他' to show the reason for his actions.

content.raw_text: 几个月以后，阿不思的名声就开始超过他父亲。第一学年快结束时，人们不再把他看作一个仇视麻瓜者的儿子，而是看作学校里一个前所未有的最聪明的学生。我们有幸成为他朋友的人，以他为榜样获益匪浅，更不用说他总是毫不吝啬地给我们以帮助和鼓励。他多年之后向我坦言，他当时就知道他最大的乐趣在于教书。

sentences.text: 几个月以后，阿不思的名声就开始超过他父亲。
sentences.translation: A few months later, Arthur's reputation began to surpass that of his father.
sentences.explanation: The structure '就开始' together indicates the beginning of an action or state.

sentences.text: 第一学年快结束时，人们不再把他看作一个仇视麻瓜者的儿子，而是看作学校里一个前所未有的最聪明的学生。
sentences.translation: As the first school year was coming to an end, people no longer saw him as the son of a Muggle-hater, but as the smartest student the school had ever seen.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases a shift in perception towards the character, from being seen as the son of a Muggle-hater to being recognized as the brightest student in the school.

sentences.text: 我们有幸成为他朋友的人，以他为榜样获益匪浅，更不用说他总是毫不吝啬地给我们以帮助和鼓励。
sentences.translation: We are fortunate to be his friends, benefiting greatly from him as a role model, not to mention that he always generously helps and encourages us.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of possessive particles, adverbial particles, and the structure of '不用说' (not to mention) in Chinese.

sentences.text: 他多年之后向我坦言，他当时就知道他最大的乐趣在于教书。
sentences.translation: Many years later, he confessed to me that he knew at the time that his greatest pleasure lay in teaching.
sentences.explanation: The structure '在于' indicates where one's greatest pleasure or interest lies.

content.raw_text: 他不仅赢得了学校颁发的各种重要奖项，而且很快就和当时最有名的魔法大师保持频繁的通信联系，包括著名炼金术士尼克·勒梅，知名历史学家巴希达·巴沙特，以及魔法理论家阿德贝·沃夫林。他的几篇论文刊登在《今日变形术》《魔咒创新》和《实用魔药大师》等学术刊物上。邓布利多的前途似乎是一片辉煌，惟一的问题就是他什么时候出任魔法部长。在后来的日子里，虽然经常有人预言他将要担任这个职务，他却从来没有当部长的野心。

sentences.text: 他不仅赢得了学校颁发的各种重要奖项，而且很快就和当时最有名的魔法大师保持频繁的通信联系，包括著名炼金术士尼克·勒梅，知名历史学家巴希达·巴沙特，以及魔法理论家阿德贝·沃夫林。
sentences.translation: He not only won various important awards given by the school, but also quickly established frequent communication with the most famous magic masters at that time, including the renowned alchemist Nick LeMay, the well-known historian Bashida Bashat, and the magic theorist Adbe Wolfen.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases a complex structure with multiple clauses and a list of names. It also introduces various professions and titles related to magic and history.

sentences.text: 他的几篇论文刊登在《今日变形术》《魔咒创新》和《实用魔药大师》等学术刊物上。
sentences.translation: His several papers were published in academic journals such as 'Today's Transfiguration', 'Innovative Spells', and 'Master of Practical Magic Potions'.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of measure words (such as '篇' for papers/articles) and the structure of listing items using '和' (and) and '等' (such as).

sentences.text: 邓布利多的前途似乎是一片辉煌，惟一的问题就是他什么时候出任魔法部长。
sentences.translation: Dumbledore's future seems to be very bright, the only question is when he will become Minister of Magic.
sentences.explanation: The sentence discusses Dumbledore's bright future and the only question being when he will become Minister of Magic. Pay attention to the structure '是...就是...' meaning 'the only...is...'.

sentences.text: 在后来的日子里，虽然经常有人预言他将要担任这个职务，他却从来没有当部长的野心。
sentences.translation: In the days that followed, although many people often predicted that he would take on this position, he never had the ambition to be a minister.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the structure of '虽然...但是...' (although...but...) and the use of '从来没有' (never) to emphasize the lack of ambition in this context.

content.raw_text: 我们入学三年后，阿不思的弟弟阿不福思也来到了霍格沃茨。兄弟两个并不像。阿不福思从来不爱读书，而且，他喜欢决斗，不喜欢通过理性来协商来解决问题，这点也不像阿不思。不过，有人说兄弟俩关系不好。这也不符合事实。他们虽然性格迥异，相处还算和睦。替阿不福思说句公道话，必须承认生活在阿不思的阴影里不是件特别舒服的事。作为他的朋友，总是被他比得黯然失色，实在有伤士气；作为一个弟弟，肯定也不会愉快多少。

sentences.text: 我们入学三年后，阿不思的弟弟阿不福思也来到了霍格沃茨。
sentences.translation: Three years after we enrolled, Arthur's younger brother, Albert's younger brother, also came to Hogwarts.
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces the arrival of Albert's younger brother to Hogwarts three years after the speaker and others enrolled. The structure '阿不思的弟弟阿不福思' means 'Arthur's younger brother, Albert'.

sentences.text: 兄弟两个并不像。
sentences.translation: The two brothers are not alike.
sentences.explanation: The structure '并不' is used to emphasize the negation, indicating that the two brothers are not similar at all.

sentences.text: 阿不福思从来不爱读书，而且他喜欢决斗，不喜欢通过理性来协商来解决问题，这点也不像阿不思。
sentences.translation: Abufusi never liked to read, and he liked dueling. He didn't like to negotiate and solve problems through reason, which is not like Absi.
sentences.explanation: The sentence contrasts the character traits of two individuals, highlighting their differences in approach to problem-solving and negotiation.

sentences.text: 不过，有人说兄弟俩关系不好。
sentences.translation: However, some people say that the relationship between the two brothers is not good.
sentences.explanation: The structure '兄弟俩' is a colloquial way to say 'the two brothers' in Chinese.

sentences.text: 这也不符合事实。
sentences.translation: This also does not conform to the facts.
sentences.explanation: The structure '不符合' means 'does not conform to' or 'does not match'.

sentences.text: 他们虽然性格迥异，相处还算和睦。
sentences.translation: Although their personalities are very different, they still get along relatively well.
sentences.explanation: The structure '虽然...，但是...' is a common way to express contrast in Chinese. In this sentence, '还算' is used to indicate that the level of getting along is acceptable or satisfactory.

sentences.text: 替阿不福思说句公道话，必须承认生活在阿不思的阴影里不是件特别舒服的事。
sentences.translation: To speak a fair word for Absalom, it must be admitted that living in Absalom's shadow is not a particularly comfortable thing.
sentences.explanation: The sentence discusses the discomfort of living in someone's shadow and the need to acknowledge it, even if speaking in their favor.

sentences.text: 作为他的朋友，总是被他比得黯然失色，实在有伤士气；
sentences.translation: As his friend, always being overshadowed by him, really hurts one's morale;
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes the feeling of being constantly overshadowed by someone, which can be demoralizing.

sentences.text: 作为一个弟弟，肯定也不会愉快多少。
sentences.translation: As a younger brother, definitely not happy much.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese places the subject '弟弟' at the beginning, followed by the verb '肯定不会' to express 'definitely not'. The word '多少' at the end emphasizes 'not much' in this context.

content.raw_text: 阿不思和我离开霍格沃茨后，打算按照当时的传统结伴周游世界，拜访和观察国外的巫师，然后再追求各自的事业。然而，悲剧从天而降。就在我们出发的前一天，阿不思的母亲坎德拉过世，阿不思成了一家之主，成了挣钱养家的顶梁柱。我推迟动身，参加了坎德拉的葬礼，然后一个人踏上了孤独的旅途。阿不思要照顾一对年幼的弟妹，家里生活拮据，他不可能和我结伴旅行了。

sentences.text: 阿不思和我离开霍格沃茨后，打算按照当时的传统结伴周游世界，拜访和观察国外的巫师，然后再追求各自的事业。
sentences.translation: After leaving Hogwarts, Harry and I planned to follow the tradition at that time, traveling the world together, visiting and observing foreign wizards, and then pursuing our own careers.
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces the plan of Harry and the speaker to travel the world together after leaving Hogwarts, visiting foreign wizards, and then pursuing their own careers. Pay attention to the possessive particle '的' which indicates possession or association.

sentences.text: 然而，悲剧从天而降。
sentences.translation: However, tragedy strikes suddenly.
sentences.explanation: The structure "从...而..." is a common way to indicate the source and manner of an action in Chinese.

sentences.text: 就在我们出发的前一天，阿不思的母亲坎德拉过世，阿不思成了一家之主，成了挣钱养家的顶梁柱。
sentences.translation: On the day before we set off, Absi's mother, Kendra, passed away. Absi became the head of the family and the main breadwinner.
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces a series of events where Absi's mother passed away, making Absi the head of the family and the main provider.

sentences.text: 我推迟动身，参加了坎德拉的葬礼，然后一个人踏上了孤独的旅途。
sentences.translation: I delayed my departure, attended Kendra's funeral, and then embarked on a lonely journey alone.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the possessive particle '的' to indicate possession or association between words. It also demonstrates the structure of '然后' (then/afterwards) to connect actions in a sequence.

sentences.text: 阿不思要照顾一对年幼的弟妹，家里生活拮据，他不可能和我结伴旅行了。
sentences.translation: Abe needs to take care of a young brother and sister. The family is financially tight, so he cannot travel with me.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the complexity of Chinese grammar with possessive particles, the use of '不可能' to indicate 'cannot', and the structure '不可能和我结伴旅行了' to express 'cannot travel with me'.

content.raw_text: 在我们的一生中，那段时间接触最少。我给阿不思写信，描绘旅途中的奇特见闻，从逃脱希腊的客迈拉（希腊神话中的狮头、羊身、蛇尾的吐火女怪）。到参观埃及炼金术士们的试验。我这么做也许太不善解人意了。他的信里很少提及他的日常生活，我猜想对于他这样一位出色的巫师来说，那肯定是乏味得令人沮丧。我沉浸在自己的游历中，一年的旅行快要结束时，悲剧再次降临在邓布利多家里，他的妹妹阿利安娜死了。我听了万分震惊。

sentences.text: 在我们的一生中，那段时间接触最少。
sentences.translation: In our lifetime, that period had the least contact.
sentences.explanation: The structure '在...中' is used to indicate 'in' or 'among' a certain period or group. The word '最少' means 'least' in this context.

sentences.text: 我给阿不思写信，描绘旅途中的奇特见闻，从逃脱希腊的客迈拉（希腊神话中的狮头，羊身，蛇尾的吐火女怪）。
sentences.translation: I wrote a letter to Absi, describing the strange sights on the journey, from escaping the Greek Chimera (a fire-breathing female monster with a lion's head, a goat's body, and a serpent's tail) .
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains a complex structure with multiple descriptive elements. The term '客迈拉' refers to the Chimera from Greek mythology, which is described with a lion's head, a goat's body, and a serpent's tail that breathes fire.

sentences.text: 到参观埃及炼金术士们的试验。
sentences.translation: To visit the experiments of the Egyptian alchemists.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure follows the pattern of 'Verb + Object + 的 + Noun' which is commonly used in Chinese to indicate possession or association.

sentences.text: 我这么做也许太不善解人意了。
sentences.translation: I may have been too insensitive in doing so.
sentences.explanation: The phrase '善解人意' is an idiom meaning 'sensitive to others' feelings'. The structure '这么...也许...太...' emphasizes the possibility of being overly insensitive.

sentences.text: 他的信里很少提及他的日常生活，我猜想对于他这样一位出色的巫师来说，那肯定是乏味得令人沮丧。
sentences.translation: His letters rarely mention his daily life, I guess for such an outstanding wizard like him, that must be boring and frustrating.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Adverb + Verb + Object, which is different from English. Also, the use of '对于' (for) and '来说' (like) in this sentence is a common structure to indicate opinion or assumption.

sentences.text: 我沉浸在自己的游历中，一年的旅行快要结束时，悲剧再次降临在邓布利多家里，他的妹妹阿利安娜死了。
sentences.translation: I was immersed in my own travels, when tragedy struck the Dumbledore family again as his sister Ariana died near the end of a year-long journey.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains possessive particles (的) and a structure where the time phrase (一年的旅行) comes before the main clause.

sentences.text: 我听了万分震惊。
sentences.translation: I was extremely shocked.
sentences.explanation: The structure '听了' indicates the completion of the action of listening, and '万分' is used to intensify the degree of shock expressed.

content.raw_text: 虽说阿利安娜长期体弱多病，但母亲刚去世不久又遭此打击，阿利安娜的两个哥哥久久难以释怀。所有与阿不思亲近的人——我自己也有幸算在内——一致认为，阿利安娜的死，以及阿不思觉得自己对此事所负的责任（当然了，他实际上并无罪责），成为他终生无法摆脱的阴影。

sentences.text: 虽说阿利安娜长期体弱多病，但母亲刚去世不久又遭此打击阿利安娜的两个哥哥久久难以释怀。
sentences.translation: Although Ariana has been weak and sickly for a long time, her mother just passed away not long ago and then suffered this blow, causing Ariana's two brothers to be unable to let go for a long time.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the emotional struggle of Ariana's two brothers after their weak and sickly sister suffered the loss of their mother and another blow.

sentences.text: 所有与阿不思亲近的人——
sentences.translation: All those close to Harry—
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces a group of people who are close to the character Harry Potter, using the possessive particle '的' to indicate the relationship.

sentences.text: 我自己也有幸算在内——
sentences.translation: I myself also have the good fortune to be included ——
sentences.explanation: The structure '算在内' means 'to be included', and the em dash '——' is used for emphasis or interruption in the sentence.

sentences.text: 一致认为，阿利安娜的死，以及阿不思觉得自己对此事所负的责任（当然了，他实际上并无罪责），成为他终生无法摆脱的阴影。
sentences.translation: It is unanimously believed that Ariana's death, as well as the responsibility that Albus feels he bears for this matter (of course, he is actually not guilty), became a shadow that he could never shake off in his lifetime.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains complex vocabulary and grammar structures, such as passive voice (使用"所"表示被动), possession particles (的, 所), and idiomatic expressions like "成为...的阴影" (become a shadow that one cannot shake off).

words.definition: used before a verb to indicate passive voice

content.raw_text: 我回国后，看到的是一个年轻人经历了与他的年龄不相称的老人的痛苦。阿不思比以前更加沉默寡言，心情也沉重许多。更令他痛苦的是，阿利安娜的死不仅没有使阿不思和阿不福思的关系更加紧密，反而使他们变得疏远了。（这种疏远逐渐改善——后来他们重新建立了关系，即使不算亲密，无疑还算友好。）然而，从那以后，阿不思很少谈及他的父母和阿利安娜，他的朋友们也避免谈论他们。

sentences.text: 我回国后，看到的是一个年轻人经历了与他的年龄不相称的老人的痛苦。
sentences.translation: After I returned to my country, what I saw was a young person experiencing the pain of an old person that did not match his age.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese may seem different from English, with the possessive particle '的' used frequently to indicate possession or attributes.

words.definition: particle indicating the completion of an action

sentences.text: 阿不思比以前更加沉默寡言，心情也沉重许多。
sentences.translation: Harry is even more silent and taciturn than before, and his mood is much heavier.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes Harry being even more silent and taciturn than before, with a much heavier mood.

sentences.text: 更令他痛苦的是，阿利安娜的死不仅没有使阿不思和阿不福思的关系更加紧密，反而使他们变得疏远了。
sentences.translation: What's even more painful for him is that Ariana's death not only did not make the relationship between Abs and Abufu closer, but instead made them more distant.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of comparisons and contrasts in Chinese grammar, as well as the structure of indicating possession with 的. It also highlights the complexity of expressing relationships and emotions in Chinese.

sentences.text: （这种疏远逐渐改善——
sentences.translation: This kind of alienation gradually improves—
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes how a certain type of alienation is slowly getting better.

sentences.text: 后来他们重新建立了关系，即使不算亲密，无疑还算友好。
sentences.translation: Later, they reestablished their relationship, although not very intimate, undoubtedly still considered friendly.
sentences.explanation: The structure '即使...，无疑还...' is a common way to express 'although...still...' in Chinese.

sentences.text: ）然而，从那以后，阿不思很少谈及他的父母和阿利安娜，他的朋友们也避免谈论他们。
sentences.translation: However, since then, Absalom rarely talked about his parents and Ariana, and his friends also avoided discussing them.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Adverb + Verb + Object. In this sentence, the adverb '很少' (rarely) is used to indicate the frequency of Absalom talking about his parents and Ariana.

content.raw_text: 此后几年，他的辉煌成就自会有人去描述。邓布利多对巫术知识宝库所做的巨大贡献，包括发现龙血的十二种用途，还有他担任威森加摩首席魔法师时在许多判决中所展示的智慧，都会使后人受益。人们还说，没有一场巫师决斗能比得上一九四五年邓布利多与格林德沃之间的较量。那些目睹过这两位非凡巫师展开决战的人们，描绘了他们当时所感受到的恐惧和敬畏。邓布利多的胜利，及其对巫师界产生的影响，被看作是魔法历史上的一个转折点，堪与《国际保密法》的出台和神秘人的垮台相提并论。

sentences.text: 此后几年，他的辉煌成就自会有人去描述。
sentences.translation: In the following years, his brilliant achievements will be described by someone.
sentences.explanation: The structure '自会' is used to indicate a future action that will definitely happen.

sentences.text: 邓布利多对巫术知识宝库所做的巨大贡献，包括发现龙血的十二种用途，还有他担任威森加摩首席魔法师时在许多判决中所展示的智慧，都会使后人受益。
sentences.translation: Dumbledore's huge contributions to the magical knowledge repository, including the discovery of twelve uses of dragon's blood, as well as the wisdom he displayed in many judgments while serving as Chief Warlock of the Wizengamot, will benefit future generations.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases complex vocabulary related to magic and judiciary, as well as the use of possessive particles and the structure of indicating the object of an action with '所'.

sentences.text: 人们还说，没有一场巫师决斗能比得上一九四五年邓布利多与格林德沃之间的较量。
sentences.translation: People also say that no wizard duel can compare to the confrontation between Dumbledore and Grindelwald in 1945.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Predicate + Object, which is different from English. The word '比得上' is a set phrase meaning 'compare to' or 'be as good as'.

sentences.text: 那些目睹过这两位非凡巫师展开决战的人们，描绘了他们当时所感受到的恐惧和敬畏。
sentences.translation: Those who witnessed the two extraordinary wizards engage in a decisive battle described the fear and awe they felt at that time.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains complex vocabulary related to magic and battle, as well as the possessive particle '的' and the adjectival particle '所'.

words.definition: used before a verb to indicate the action's object

sentences.text: 邓布利多的胜利，及其对巫师界产生的影响，被看作是魔法历史上的一个转折点，堪与《国际保密法》的出台和神秘人的垮台相提并论。
sentences.translation: Dumbledore's victory, and its impact on the wizarding world, is seen as a turning point in magical history, comparable to the enactment of the International Statute of Secrecy and the downfall of the mysterious figure.
sentences.explanation: This sentence discusses the significance of Dumbledore's victory in the wizarding world, comparing it to major events like the enactment of the International Statute of Secrecy and the downfall of a mysterious figure.

content.raw_text: 阿不思·邓布利多从不恃才傲物，追求虚荣。他总能发现别人身上值得珍视的东西，不管那个人表面看去多么落魄和不起眼。我相信，是他早年痛失亲人的经历，赋予了他博大的仁慈和悲悯之心。我将无比怀念他的友情，然而，跟整个巫师界相比，我个人的损失实在不算什么。毫无疑问，他是霍格沃茨历届校长中最有感召力、最受人爱戴的一位，无论活着时还是死去时，总是为更崇高的利益而工作，直到生命的最后一刻，就像我第一次见到他的那天，他向一个患龙痘疮的小男孩友好地伸出了手。

sentences.text: 阿不思·邓布利多从不恃才傲物，追求虚荣。
sentences.translation: Albus Dumbledore never relies on his talents to be arrogant towards others, he pursues vanity.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Adverb + Verb + Object, which is different from English. The use of 阿不思·邓布利多 is a cultural reference to the character Albus Dumbledore from the Harry Potter series.

sentences.text: 他总能发现别人身上值得珍视的东西，不管那个人表面看去多么落魄和不起眼。
sentences.translation: He always manages to find something valuable in others, no matter how shabby and inconspicuous they may appear on the surface.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the speaker's ability to see the value in others, even if they may seem unremarkable at first glance.

sentences.text: 我相信，是他早年痛失亲人的经历，赋予了他博大的仁慈和悲悯之心。
sentences.translation: I believe that it was his early experience of losing loved ones that endowed him with a generous heart full of compassion.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese places the descriptive words before the noun they describe, which is different from English. For example, '博大的仁慈' means 'generous kindness'.

sentences.text: 我将无比怀念他的友情，然而，跟整个巫师界相比，我个人的损失实在不算什么。
sentences.translation: I will greatly miss his friendship, however, compared to the entire wizarding world, my personal loss is really nothing.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of possessive particles in Chinese, as well as the comparison structure '跟...相比' meaning 'compared to'.

sentences.text: 毫无疑问，他是霍格沃茨历届校长中最有感召力，最受人爱戴的一位，无论活着时还是死去时，总是为更崇高的利益而工作，直到生命的最后一刻，就像我第一次见到他的那天，他向一个患龙痘疮的小男孩友好地伸出了手。
sentences.translation: Without a doubt, he is the most charismatic and beloved among all the former headmasters of Hogwarts, always working for a higher cause, whether in life or in death, until the very last moment of his life, just like the day I first met him when he kindly reached out his hand to a little boy suffering from dragon pox.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases a complex structure with multiple clauses and descriptive elements. It also includes idiomatic expressions like '直到生命的最后一刻' (until the very last moment of his life) and '就像我第一次见到他的那天' (just like the day I first met him).

content.raw_text: 哈利读完了，但仍然凝视着讣文旁的那张照片。邓布利多脸上带着那种熟悉的、慈祥的微笑，但从半月形镜片上望过来的目光——虽然是印在报纸上的，却仿佛正用Ｘ光审视着哈利，使哈利觉得又伤心，又有一种羞愧感。

sentences.text: 哈利读完了，但仍然凝视着讣文旁的那张照片。
sentences.translation: Harry finished reading, but still gazed at the photo next to the obituary.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Verb + Object. The measure word '张' is used for flat objects like photos in Chinese.

words.definition: measure word for flat objects like photos

sentences.text: 邓布利多脸上带着那种熟悉的，慈祥微笑，但从半月形镜片上望过来的目光——
sentences.translation: Dumbledore's face carried that familiar, kind smile, but the gaze that looked over the half-moon spectacles—
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes the appearance of Dumbledore, focusing on his kind smile and the gaze from his half-moon spectacles.

sentences.text: 虽然是印在报纸上的，却仿佛正用Ｘ光审视着哈利使哈利觉得又伤心，又有一种羞愧感。
sentences.translation: Although it was printed in the newspaper, it seemed as if it was examining Harry with X-rays, making Harry feel sad and ashamed.
sentences.explanation: The structure '虽然...却...' is used to express a contrast between two clauses. The use of '仿佛' indicates a comparison or likeness, and '使' is used to indicate the cause of an emotional reaction.

content.raw_text: 他曾经以为自己很了解邓布利多，可是读了这篇讣文，他不得不承认他对邓布利多几乎一无所知。他从来没有想象过邓布利多的童年和青年时代，似乎邓布利多一下子就变成了哈利认识他的那个样子，年高德劭，须发银白。想到少年时期的邓布利多，总使人感觉很怪异，就好像要想象一个头脑迟钝的赫敏，或想象一只待人友善的炸尾螺。

sentences.text: 他曾经以为自己很了解邓布利多，可是读了这篇讣文，他不得不承认他对邓布利多几乎一无所知。
sentences.translation: He once thought he knew Dumbledore very well, but after reading this obituary, he had to admit that he knew almost nothing about Dumbledore.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the structure '不得不' (have to) in Chinese grammar. It also highlights the contrast between the speaker's previous belief and the new realization after reading the obituary.

words.definition: measure word for articles, essays, etc.

sentences.text: 他从来没有想象过邓布利多的童年和青年时代，似乎邓布利多一下子就变成了哈利认识他的那个样子，年高德劭，须发银白。
sentences.translation: He never imagined Dumbledore's childhood and youth, as if Dumbledore suddenly became the person Harry knew, old and dignified, with silver-white hair.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes how the speaker never thought about Dumbledore's past, and suddenly Dumbledore seemed to transform into the older and dignified version that Harry knew, with silver-white hair.

sentences.text: 想到少年时期的邓布利多，总使人感觉很怪异，就好像要想象一个头脑迟钝的赫敏，或想象一只待人友善的炸尾螺。
sentences.translation: Thinking of the young Dumbledore always feels very strange, as if trying to imagine a dull-witted Hermione, or imagining a friendly Blast-Ended Skrewt.
sentences.explanation: This sentence uses similes to convey the strange feeling of imagining a young Dumbledore, comparing it to imagining a dull-witted Hermione or a friendly Blast-Ended Skrewt.

words.definition: to want; to be going to

content.raw_text: 他从来没有想过问问邓布利多的过去。当然啦，那么做会显得有点别扭，甚至冒昧，但是邓布利多参加了与格林德沃的那场传奇般的决斗，这是尽人皆知的事实，而哈利居然没有想到向邓布利多问问当时的情景，也没有向他问问他的其他著名成就。没有，他们总是在谈论哈利，哈利的过去，哈利的未来，哈利的计划……而现在哈利感觉到，尽管他的未来确实危机四伏，前途未卜，但他失去的机会再也无法挽回：他没有向邓布利多询问有关他自己的更多情况，而他向校长提出的惟一一个私人问题，却是他怀疑邓布利多惟一没有做出诚实回答的问题：

sentences.text: 他从来没有想过问问邓布利多的过去。
sentences.translation: He never thought to ask about Dumbledore's past.
sentences.explanation: The structure '从来没有' means 'never' in this context. The repetition of '问' (ask) in '想过问问' emphasizes the act of asking.

sentences.text: 当然啦，那么做会显得有点别扭，甚至冒昧，但是邓布利多参加了与格林德沃的那场传奇般的决斗，这是尽人皆知的事实，而哈利居然没有想到向邓布利多问问当时的情景，也没有向他问问他的其他著名成就。
sentences.translation: Of course, doing so would seem a bit awkward and even presumptuous, but it is a well-known fact that Dumbledore participated in the legendary duel with Grindelwald. Harry surprisingly did not think to ask Dumbledore about the situation at that time, nor did he inquire about his other famous achievements.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains complex structures such as expressing surprise with '居然', using '没有' twice for negation, and the repetition of '问问' for asking questions. It also introduces the historical context of a legendary duel between Dumbledore and Grindelwald.

sentences.text: 没有，他们总是在谈论哈利，哈利的过去，哈利的未来，哈利的计划…
sentences.translation: No, they always talk about Harry, Harry's past, Harry's future, Harry's plans...
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is subject + adverb + verb + object, with the repetition of 'Harry' and possessive '的' indicating the focus on Harry in the conversation.
This sentence contains an ellipsis, which indicates that there is more to come or something is omitted.

sentences.text: 而现在哈利感觉到，尽管他的未来确实危机四伏，前途未卜，但他失去的机会再也无法挽回：他没有向邓布利多询问有关他自己的更多情况，而他向校长提出的惟一一个私人问题，却是他怀疑邓布利多惟一没有做出诚实回答的问题：
sentences.translation: And now Harry felt that, although his future was indeed full of crisis and uncertainties, the opportunity he had lost could never be regained: he did not ask Dumbledore for more information about himself, and the only personal question he asked the headmaster was the one he suspected Dumbledore had not given an honest answer to:
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains complex structures such as the use of '而' to connect clauses, the expression '再也' to indicate 'never again', and the use of '惟一' to mean 'only'. It also shows the contrast between Harry not asking Dumbledore for more information about himself, but asking a personal question he suspected Dumbledore had not given an honest answer to.

content.raw_text: “你照魔镜的时候，看见了什么？”

sentences.text: “你照魔镜的时候，看见了什么？
sentences.translation: When you looked into the magic mirror, what did you see?
sentences.explanation: The structure '你...的时候' is a common way to express 'when you...' in Chinese.
The sentence contains a quotation mark and an ellipsis, which are important punctuation marks in Chinese text.

sentences.explanation: The sentence consists of the pronoun '我' meaning 'I/me' followed by a question mark '？' indicating a question. The speaker is questioning themselves.

sentences.text: 我看见自己拿着一双厚厚的羊毛袜。
sentences.translation: I saw myself holding a pair of thick woolen socks.
sentences.explanation: The structure '拿着' indicates the action of holding something, and '一双' is a measure word used for pairs of items.
This sentence only consists of punctuation marks, indicating a pause or continuation in the text.

sentences.text: 哈利沉思了几分钟，把讣文从《预言家日报》上撕下来，仔细折叠，夹在了《实用防御魔法及其对黑魔法的克制》第一册里。
sentences.translation: Harry pondered for a few minutes, tore the obituary from the Daily Prophet, carefully folded it, and tucked it into the first volume of 'Practical Defensive Magic and its Use Against the Dark Arts'.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the particle '了' to indicate a completed action, as well as the structure '把...夹在...' meaning 'tucked...into...'.

sentences.text: 他把剩下来的报纸扔在垃圾堆上，转身望着房间。
sentences.translation: He threw the remaining newspapers onto the garbage pile and turned to look at the room.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...扔在...' is a common way in Chinese to indicate throwing something onto a surface.

words.definition: indicating the object of the action

sentences.text: 房间里整洁多了。
sentences.translation: The room is much tidier.
sentences.explanation: The structure '整洁多了' indicates that the room has become tidier compared to before.

sentences.text: 惟一放得不是地方的是当天的《预言家日报》，仍然摊在床上，上面压着那块破碎的镜片。
sentences.translation: The only thing out of place was the 'Prophet Daily' from that day, still spread out on the bed, with a broken piece of mirror on top of it.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains possessive particles '的' after nouns, which is a common structure in Chinese to indicate possession.

content.raw_text: 哈利走过去，把碎镜片从当天的《预言家日报》上抖落，然后展开了报纸。早晨他从猫头鹰邮差那里接过卷成筒状的报纸，匆匆扫了一眼标题，发现没有伏地魔的消息，就把它扔到了一边。哈利相信是魔法部给《预言家日报》施加了压力，要求封锁关于伏地魔的消息。直到这时，他才发现自己漏掉了什么。

sentences.text: 哈利走过去，把碎镜片从当天的《预言家日报》上抖落，然后展开了报纸。
sentences.translation: Harry walked over, shook off the broken pieces of the mirror from that day's 'Daily Prophet', and then unfolded the newspaper.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the use of the particle '把' to introduce the object of an action, as well as the possessive particle '的'.

words.definition: particle used to introduce the object of an action

sentences.text: 早晨他从猫头鹰邮差那里接过卷成筒状的报纸，匆匆扫了一眼标题，发现没有伏地魔的消息，就把它扔到了一边。
sentences.translation: In the morning, he took the rolled-up newspaper from the owl postman, quickly scanned the headlines, found no news about Voldemort, and then threw it aside.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of particle '的' to indicate possession, the structure '把...扔到' meaning 'throw aside', and the word '伏地魔' for 'Voldemort'.

sentences.text: 哈利相信是魔法部给《预言家日报》施加了压力，要求封锁关于伏地魔的消息。
sentences.translation: Harry believes that the Ministry of Magic pressured the Daily Prophet to block news about Voldemort.
sentences.explanation: The structure '是...给...' is used to indicate that someone or something is the recipient of an action.

sentences.text: 直到这时，他才发现自己漏掉了什么。
sentences.translation: It was not until this moment that he realized what he had missed.
sentences.explanation: The structure '才...就...' indicates that the action happened later than expected. In this sentence, it emphasizes that the realization occurred only at this moment.

content.raw_text: 在报纸头版的下半页，有一幅邓布利多神色匆匆、大步行走的照片，上面略小一点的标题是：

sentences.text: 在报纸头版的下半页，有一幅邓布利多神色匆匆，大步行走的照片，上面略小一点的标题是：
sentences.translation: On the bottom half of the front page of the newspaper, there is a photo of Dumbledore walking hurriedly with a big stride, and above it is a slightly smaller title:
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes a scene from a newspaper article, mentioning a photo of Dumbledore walking hurriedly with a big stride.

content.raw_text: 邓布利多——终于真相大白？

sentences.text: 邓布利多——
sentences.translation: Dumbledore——
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a name 'Dumbledore' followed by an em dash.

sentences.text: 终于真相大白？
sentences.translation: Finally, the truth is revealed?
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is a simple question in Chinese, where the truth being revealed is expressed with the word '大白' (revealed) following the noun '真相' (truth). The question mark '？' at the end indicates it is a question.

content.raw_text: 一部令人震惊的传记下周问世，主角是那位有缺陷的天才，许多人认为他是他所属的时代最伟大的巫师。丽塔·斯基特剥去了那个深受大家喜爱的须发银白的智者形象的外衣，揭露了邓布利多动荡的童年和混乱的青春时代、他终生的仇敌，以及他带入坟墓的那些罪恶的秘密。为什么这个有望成为魔法部部长的人仅满足于当一名校长？那个名为凤凰社的秘密组织的真正目的是什么？邓布利多究竟是怎么死的？

sentences.text: 一部令人震惊的传记下周问世，主角是那位有缺陷的天才，许多人认为他是他所属的时代最伟大的巫师。
sentences.translation: A shocking biography will be published next week, with the protagonist being that flawed genius, many people believe he is the greatest wizard of his era.
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces a shocking biography about a flawed genius who is believed by many to be the greatest wizard of his era. Pay attention to the possessive particle '的' which is used frequently in Chinese to indicate possession or association.

sentences.text: 丽塔·斯基特剥去了那个深受大家喜爱的须发银白的智者形象的外衣，揭露了邓布利多动荡的童年和混乱的青春时代，他终生的仇敌，以及他带入坟墓的那些罪恶的秘密。
sentences.translation: Rita Skeeter stripped away the beloved image of the wise silver-haired sage, revealing Dumbledore's turbulent childhood and chaotic youth, his lifelong enemies, and the dark secrets he took to the grave.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes how Rita Skeeter revealed the hidden aspects of Dumbledore's life, including his troubled past and dark secrets.

sentences.text: 为什么这个有望成为魔法部部长的人仅满足于当一名校长？
sentences.translation: Why is this person, who is likely to become the Minister of Magic, content with being just a headmaster?
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese may seem unusual to English speakers, with the verb '满足' (content/satisfied) placed before the preposition '于' (at). Additionally, the measure word '一名' is used before '校长' to indicate 'a headmaster.'

sentences.text: 那个名为凤凰社的秘密组织的真正目的是什么？
sentences.translation: What is the true purpose of the secret organization called Phoenix Society?
sentences.explanation: This sentence structure is a typical Chinese question format where the subject is followed by the verb and then the object. The word '的' is a possessive particle indicating possession or association.

sentences.text: 邓布利多究竟是怎么死的？
sentences.translation: How did Dumbledore die?
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is a question asking about the way in which Dumbledore died. The use of '怎么' together means 'how'.

content.raw_text: 这些以及更多问题的答案，都在丽塔·斯基特最新出版的爆炸性传记《阿不思·邓布利多的生平与谎言》中做了探究，贝蒂·布雷思韦特对传记作者做了独家采访，见本报第13版。

sentences.text: 这些以及更多问题的答案，都在丽塔·斯基特最新出版的爆炸性传记《阿不思·邓布利多的生平与谎言》中做了探究，贝蒂·布雷思韦特对传记作者做了独家采访，见本报第13版。
sentences.translation: The answers to these and many more questions are explored in Rita Skeeter's latest explosive biography 'The Life and Lies of Albus Dumbledore', Betty Braithwaite conducted an exclusive interview with the biographer, see page 13 of this newspaper.
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces a book title, an author, and an exclusive interview, providing information about where to find more details in a newspaper.

content.raw_text: 哈利扯开报纸，找到第13版。文章上面有幅照片，又是一张熟悉的脸：一个女人戴着一副镶着珠宝的眼睛，一头金发弄成精致的大卷儿，牙齿露着，绽开一个显然自以为很迷人的笑容，手指张开朝哈利摆动着。哈利尽量不去看这令人恶心的照片，继续往下读。

sentences.text: 哈利扯开报纸，找到第13版。
sentences.translation: Harry opened the newspaper and found the 13th edition.
sentences.explanation: The tricky part here is the use of the ordinal number prefix '第' before '13' to indicate the 13th edition.

sentences.text: 文章上面有幅照片，又是一张熟悉的脸：一个女人戴着一副镶着珠宝的眼睛，一头金发弄成精致的大卷儿，牙齿露着，绽开一个显然自以为很迷人的笑容，手指张开朝哈利摆动着。
sentences.translation: Above the article is a photo, again a familiar face: a woman wearing a pair of jewel-encrusted eyes, with finely styled big curls of golden hair, teeth showing, displaying an obviously self-perceived charming smile, fingers spread out waving towards Harry.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains various descriptive words and phrases to paint a vivid picture of the woman in the photo. Pay attention to the possessive particles 的 and the structure 自以为 (self-perceived) in the sentence.

sentences.text: 哈利尽量不去看这令人恶心的照片，继续往下读。
sentences.translation: Harry tried his best not to look at these disgusting photos and continued reading.
sentences.explanation: The structure '尽量不去' means 'try one's best not to'. The possessive particle '的' is used to indicate that the photos are disgusting.

content.raw_text: 丽塔·斯基特的文笔以犀利著称，但她本人却热情随和得多。在她那温暖舒适的家中，她在门厅里迎接了我，把我直接领进厨房，喝茶，吃一片重糖重油的蛋糕，当然啦，还有刚出锅的、热气腾腾的聊天话题。

sentences.text: 丽塔·斯基特的文笔以犀利著称，但她本人却热情随和得多。
sentences.translation: Rita Skeeter is known for her sharp writing style, but she herself is much more warm and easy-going.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contrasts Rita Skeeter's sharp writing style with her warm and easy-going personality.

sentences.text: 在她那温暖舒适的家中，她在门厅里迎接了我，把我直接领进厨房，喝茶，吃一片重糖重油的蛋糕，当然啦，还有刚出锅的，热气腾腾的聊天话题。
sentences.translation: In her warm and comfortable home, she welcomed me in the hallway, led me straight into the kitchen, served tea, a piece of heavy sugary and oily cake, and of course, freshly baked, steaming hot topics for conversation.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases a typical hospitality gesture in Chinese culture, where the host welcomes the guest with tea, snacks, and engaging conversation topics.

content.raw_text: “不用说，邓布利多是一个传记作家梦寐以求的人物，”斯基特说，“这么漫长而丰富的一生。我的书是第一本，我相信后面会有许多许多。”

sentences.text: “不用说，邓布利多是一个传记作家梦寐以求的人物，”斯基特说，“这么漫长而丰富的一生。
sentences.translation: No need to say, Dumbledore is a figure that biographers dream of," Skeeter said, "such a long and rich life.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese allows for the use of descriptive words before the noun they modify, which may differ from English word order.

sentences.text: 我的书是第一本，我相信后面会有许多许多。
sentences.translation: My book is the first one, I believe there will be many more after.
sentences.explanation: The structure '会有' indicates a future action, and '许多' is used to express 'many' or 'a lot' in this context.
The sentence consists of a quotation mark followed by the characters for 'return' and 'memory', indicating the title of the chapter '回忆' (Memories).

content.raw_text: 斯基特无疑是个快手。这本长达九百页的传记仅在邓布利多六月份神秘死亡的四个星期后就完成了。我问她怎么能做到如此神速。

sentences.text: 斯基特无疑是个快手。
sentences.translation: Skate is undoubtedly a fast hand.
sentences.explanation: The term '快手' in this context refers to someone who is quick or skilled at doing something.

sentences.text: 这本长达九百页的传记仅在邓布利多六月份神秘死亡的四个星期后就完成了。
sentences.translation: This nine-hundred-page biography was completed just four weeks after the mysterious death of Dumbledore in June.
sentences.explanation: The structure '在...后' is used to indicate 'after' in Chinese. The word '就' is used to express that an action happens very soon after another action.

words.definition: (indicating that something happens very soon after something else)

sentences.text: 我问她怎么能做到如此神速。
sentences.translation: I asked her how she could do it so quickly.
sentences.explanation: The structure 怎么能 (how can) is commonly used to ask how something is achievable or possible.

content.raw_text: “噢，如果你像我一样做了这么多年的记者，抢时间就成了第二天性。我知道巫师如饥似渴地想要一本完整的传记，我希望第一个满足这种的需要。”

sentences.text: “噢，如果你像我一样做了这么多年的记者，抢时间就成了第二天性。
sentences.translation: Oh, if you have been a journalist like me for so many years, rushing against time becomes second nature.
sentences.explanation: The structure '抢时间就成了第二天性' means 'rushing against time becomes second nature'. The phrase '第二天性' is an idiom meaning 'second nature'.

sentences.text: 我知道巫师如饥似渴地想要一本完整的传记，我希望第一个满足这种的需要。
sentences.translation: I know that wizards are eager for a complete biography, and I hope to be the first to meet this need.
sentences.explanation: The structure '如...地' is a common way to express 'like' or 'similar to' in Chinese. The measure word '本' is used for books in this context. The particle '的' is used to indicate possession or modification.
The sentence contains a quotation mark and an ellipsis, which are important punctuation marks to note in Chinese text.

content.raw_text: 我提到最广为流传的埃非亚斯·多吉的评论，他是威森加摩的特别顾问，也是阿不思·邓布利多长期的朋友，他说“斯基特书里所包含的事实，还不如一张巧克力蛙卡片”。

sentences.text: 我提到最广为流传的埃非亚斯·多吉的评论，他是威森加摩的特别顾问，也是阿不思·邓布利多长期的朋友，他说“斯基特书里所包含的事实，还不如一张巧克力蛙卡片”。
sentences.translation: I mentioned the most widely circulated comment by Elias Doge, who is a special advisor to Wizengamot and a long-time friend of Albus Dumbledore. He said, 'The facts contained in Skeeter's book are not even worth a Chocolate Frog Card.'
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces a comparison structure '不如' meaning 'not as good as'. The phrase '斯基特书里所包含的事实' means 'the facts contained in Skeeter's book'. The term '巧克力蛙卡片' refers to a Chocolate Frog Card, a popular collectible item in the wizarding world of Harry Potter.

sentences.explanation: The sentence describes Skid looking up to the sky and laughing heartily.

sentences.translation: I remember interviewing him a few years ago for the issue of mermaid rights, may God bless him.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the use of past experiences with the character '过' to indicate interviewing someone in the past. The phrase '老天保佑' is a common expression to wish someone well or ask for God's blessing.

sentences.text: 整个儿一个老糊涂，好像以为我们坐在温德米尔湖（英国中西部坎布里亚郡内的湖泊）的湖底，不停地叫我提防鲑鱼。
sentences.translation: The whole person is a bit confused, as if thinking we are sitting at the bottom of Lake Windermere (a lake in Cumbria County, central-west England), constantly warning me to beware of salmon.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a situation where someone is confused and mistakenly believes they are underwater in a lake in England, being warned about salmon.
The sentence contains a quotation mark and an ellipsis, which are important punctuation marks in Chinese text.

content.raw_text: 可是，许多媒体都转载了埃非亚斯·多吉指责传记错误百出的话。难道斯基特真的觉得短短四个星期就足以充分描绘邓布利多漫长而极不平凡的一生吗？

sentences.text: 可是，许多媒体都转载了埃非亚斯·多吉指责传记错误百出的话。
sentences.translation: However, many media outlets have reprinted Elias Doge's accusations of numerous errors in the biography.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the possessive particle '的' to indicate the relationship between '传记' (biography) and '错误百出' (numerous errors).

sentences.text: 难道斯基特真的觉得短短四个星期就足以充分描绘邓布利多漫长而极不平凡的一生吗？
sentences.translation: Does Skeeter really think that a mere four weeks is enough to fully depict Dumbledore's long and extremely extraordinary life?
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure involves using 难道 (does it really) at the beginning to express doubt, followed by the main question about whether Skeeter thinks four weeks is enough to depict Dumbledore's life.

content.raw_text: “哦，亲爱的，”斯基特笑容满面地说，一边亲切地拍拍我的手，“你和我一样清楚，有了一袋沉甸甸的金加隆，一股打破砂锅问到底的劲头，还有一支漂亮而锋利的速记羽毛笔，就能套出多少情报来呀！而且，人们都排着队要说邓布利多的闲话呢。你知道，并不是人人都认为他有那么出色——他得罪了太多重要人物。不过，老滑头多吉可以从他高高在上的鹰头马身有翼兽上下来了，因为我找到了大多数记者愿意用魔杖交换的消息来源：此人以前从未当众发表过讲话，却在邓布利多极其动荡不安的青年时代与他关系密切。”

sentences.translation: You know, not everyone thinks he is so outstanding —

sentences.text: 他得罪了太多重要人物。
sentences.translation: He offended too many important figures.
sentences.explanation: The structure '太多' (too many) followed by '重要人物' (important figures) may be a challenging vocabulary combination for learners.

sentences.text: 不过，老滑头多吉可以从他高高在上的鹰头马身有翼兽上下来了，因为我找到了大多数记者愿意用魔杖交换的消息来源：此人以前从未当众发表过讲话，却在邓布利多极其动荡不安的青年时代与他关系密切。
sentences.translation: However, the old slippery Dodgy can come down from his high eagle-headed horse with wings, because I found the source of information that most reporters are willing to exchange for a wand: this person has never spoken publicly before, but had a close relationship with Dumbledore during his extremely turbulent youth.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains complex vocabulary and a long descriptive structure. It describes the ability of a character to come down from a mythical creature, and the background of a person's relationship with Dumbledore during his youth.
The sentence contains a closing quotation mark and an ellipsis, which indicates that there is more text following this sentence.

content.raw_text: 斯基特这部传记的新书广告明确提出，对于那些相信邓布利多一生白璧无瑕的人们来说，等待他们的将是强烈的震惊。那么，她发现的最令人惊诧的秘密是什么呢？

sentences.text: 斯基特这部传记的新书广告明确提出，对于那些相信邓布利多一生白璧无瑕的人们来说，等待他们的将是强烈的震惊。
sentences.translation: The new book advertisement for Skeeter's biography clearly states that for those who believe Dumbledore led a flawless life, what awaits them will be a strong shock.
sentences.explanation: This sentence discusses the advertisement for a new book about Skeeter's biography, emphasizing that those who believe Dumbledore led a flawless life will be in for a strong shock.

sentences.text: 那么，她发现的最令人惊诧的秘密是什么呢？
sentences.translation: So, what is the most surprising secret she discovered?
sentences.explanation: The structure '最...的' is used to emphasize the superlative form of an adjective, in this case, 'most surprising'. The final '呢' is a modal particle used to indicate a question.

content.raw_text: “行啦，别说了，贝蒂，在大家买到书前，我是不会把最精彩的内容透露出来的！”斯基特大笑着说，“不过我可以保证，凡是仍然认为邓布利多像他的胡须一样清白的人，都会猛然从梦中惊醒！如此，那些听说他对神秘人义愤填膺的人，做梦也不会想到他本人年轻时就曾涉足黑魔法！他晚年呼吁宽容，年轻时却心胸狭隘！是的，阿不思·邓布利多有一个极为不可告人的过去，更不用说他那个非常可疑的家庭，对此他想尽办法，百般遮掩。”

sentences.text: “行啦，别说了，贝蒂，在大家买到书前，我是不会把最精彩的内容透露出来的！
sentences.translation: Alright, stop talking, Betty, I won't reveal the most exciting content until everyone buys the book!
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a complex structure with multiple clauses and particles. The use of '把' shifts the object '最精彩的内容' before the verb '透露', which might be confusing for learners. Also, the use of '在...前' indicates 'before' in this context.

words.definition: (particle used to shift object to before the verb)

sentences.text: ”斯基特大笑着说，“不过我可以保证，凡是仍然认为邓布利多像他的胡须一样清白的人，都会猛然从梦中惊醒！
sentences.translation: Skeeter laughed and said, 'But I can guarantee that anyone who still thinks Dumbledore is as innocent as his beard will suddenly wake up from their dream!'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a complex structure with multiple clauses and a metaphor comparing Dumbledore's innocence to his beard's whiteness.

sentences.text: 如此，那些听说他对神秘人义愤填膺的人，做梦也不会想到他本人年轻时就曾涉足黑魔法！
sentences.translation: In this way, those who heard about his indignation towards the mysterious person would never dream that he had dabbled in black magic when he was young!
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes how people who knew about his strong feelings towards the mysterious person would never imagine that he had been involved in black magic when he was young. The structure '做梦也不会想到' means 'would never dream of' in English.

sentences.text: 他晚年呼吁宽容，年轻时却心胸狭隘！
sentences.translation: He called for tolerance in his later years, but was narrow-minded when he was young!
sentences.explanation: The sentence contrasts the character's behavior in his later years with his behavior when he was young, highlighting a change in attitude over time.

sentences.text: 是的，阿不思·邓布利多有一个极为不可告人的过去，更不用说他那个非常可疑的家庭，对此他想尽办法，百般遮掩。
sentences.translation: Yes, Albus Dumbledore has a very unspeakable past, not to mention his very suspicious family, about which he tries all means to cover up.
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the character Albus Dumbledore and mentions his mysterious past and suspicious family, which he tries hard to conceal.
The sentence contains a quotation mark and an ellipsis, which are important punctuation marks to note in Chinese text.

content.raw_text: 我问斯基特是不是指邓布利多的弟弟阿不福思，十五年前他因滥用魔法被威森加摩定罪，成为当时的一个小小的丑闻。

sentences.text: 我问斯基特是不是指邓布利多的弟弟阿不福思，十五年前他因滥用魔法被威森加摩定罪，成为当时的一个小小的丑闻。
sentences.translation: I asked if Skeeter was referring to Dumbledore's brother Aberforth, who was convicted by the Wizengamot fifteen years ago for the misuse of magic, becoming a minor scandal at the time.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains complex vocabulary related to the Harry Potter universe, including character names and magical terms. The structure of the sentence is relatively straightforward, with a subject-verb-object pattern.

content.raw_text: “噢，阿不福思只是粪堆的一角，”斯基特笑着说，“不是，不是，我谈论的事情比一个喜欢捉弄山羊的弟弟严重得多，甚至比那个残害麻瓜的父亲还要严重——他们都受到过威森加摩的指控，所以邓布利多不可能把这两件事遮掩住。不，激起我好奇心的是他的母亲和妹妹，我稍加挖掘，发现了一连串肮脏的事情——不过，我说过了，欲知详情，你需要阅读第九章到第十二章。我现在所能说的是，怪不得邓布利多从来闭口不谈他的鼻子是怎么破的。”

sentences.text: “噢，阿不福思只是粪堆的一角，”斯基特笑着说，不是，不是，我谈论的事情比一个喜欢捉弄山羊的弟弟严重得多，甚至比那个残害麻瓜的父亲还要严重——

sentences.text: 他们都受到过威森加摩的指控，所以邓布利多不可能把这两件事遮掩住。
sentences.translation: They have all been accused by Grindelwald, so Dumbledore cannot cover up these two things.
